name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
label: Quest
description: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.
Find him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can feel my spirit healing, friend. You have done my husband and I a great service, but I am certain there is more to be done.
